message: I need your help. Something terrible is happening.
They're watching me. I don't have much time.
My name is Sarah. I'm a researcher at NexusCorp.
I discovered something... something they don't want anyone to know.
The project... Project Midnight. It's not what they told us.
I'm sending you encrypted files. You need to decrypt them.
The password is hidden in plain sight. Look at the timestamps.
Wait... someone's at the door. I need to go dark for a while.
But we can. If you're smart enough.
Welcome to the game. Your choices matter. Choose wisely.
Sarah trusted you. Don't let her down. The truth is out there.
